mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, the temperature is 51 degrees with overcast skies near Harriet Park. We are currently under a waning crescent moon phase.

The Public Works Department is working hard on road maintenance, including upcoming asphalt repairs on November 9 and 10 on North Nine Mound Road and beyond. Also, please join us in welcoming Deputy Chief Liz Gay to the EMS team.
We have a busy schedule today with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, don't miss trivia at The Bogey Factory tomorrow.
On October 25, officers responded to a situation where a driver was found unconscious at an intersection, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor is the delicious Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently open and will be serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
